title: The Lazarus Project (TV series)
premise_summary: The Lazarus Project is a British science fiction television series created by Joe Barton and starring Paapa Essiedu. The series premiered on 16 June 2022 on Sky Max. In August 2022, it was renewed for a second series, which premiered on 15 November 2023. In March 2024, the show was cancelled after two series.
